newsitem.title: USA: Frontier CEO Bittner undergoes brain surgery.
newsitem.headline: Frontier CEO Bittner undergoes brain surgery.

text.p: Frontier Corp said on Thursday that chairman and chief executive Ronald Bittner underwent emergency surgery on Dec. 31, 1996, to remove a brain tumor and is currently "alert and resting comfortably."
While Bittner recuperates, the company said the executive team responsible for day-to-day operations will work closely with both Bittner and the Frontier board of directors.
Frontier is the parent company whose long distance, local telephone, and wireless communications subsidiaries provide a range of integrated services to customers.
